# Foca Studio
> Indie apps by Yating Lu: Foca, Dayfold, Core.
## Apps
- Foca: Pomodoro focus timer (iPhone, Mac, and Android)
- Dayfold: Countdown & anniversary widgets (iPhone)
- Core: Interval & HIIT timer (iPhone)
## Site
- Home: https://foca.work/
- Dayfold: https://foca.work/dayfold.html
- Core: https://foca.work/core.html
- Android notification FAQ: https://foca.work/faq.html
